# pve_ceph_pool_status (Data Source)

Current status of one Ceph pool (application, autoscaler, placement groups).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ceph_pool_status" "example" {
name = "CHANGE_ME"
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the pool. It must be unique.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `verbose` (Boolean) If enabled, will display additional data(eg. statistics). (default: 0)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<name>.
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (Number) Numeric pool id assigned by Ceph.
- `application` (String) The application of the pool.
- `application_list` (List of String) Names of applications currently associated with the pool.
- `autoscale_status` (Attributes) Raw pg_autoscaler status object for this pool; shape varies between Ceph releases. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--autoscale_status))
- `crush_rule` (String) The rule to use for mapping object placement in the cluster.
- `fast_read` (Boolean) Set if the pool uses fast-read for erasure-coded reads.
- `hashpspool` (Boolean) Set if the pool hashes pool id into its CRUSH placement-seed.
- `min_size` (Number) Minimum number of replicas per object
- `name` (String) The name of the pool. It must be unique.
- `nodeep_scrub` (Boolean) Set if deep-scrubbing is disabled for this pool.
- `nodelete` (Boolean) Set if pool delete is blocked.
- `nopgchange` (Boolean) Set if changing the placement-group count is blocked.
- `noscrub` (Boolean) Set if scrubbing is disabled for this pool.
- `nosizechange` (Boolean) Set if changing the replication size is blocked.
- `pg_autoscale_mode` (String) The automatic PG scaling mode of the pool.
- `pg_num` (Number) Number of placement groups.
- `pg_num_min` (Number) Minimal number of placement groups.
- `pgp_num` (Number) Placement-group-for-placement count.
- `size` (Number) Number of replicas per object
- `statistics` (Attributes) Optional pool usage and IO statistics (only present when verbose=1 is requested). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--statistics))
- `target_size` (String) The estimated target size of the pool for the PG autoscaler.
- `target_size_ratio` (Number) The estimated target ratio of the pool for the PG autoscaler.
- `use_gmt_hitset` (Boolean) Set if hitsets use GMT timestamps (for cache-tier pools).
- `write_fadvise_dontneed` (Boolean) Set if the pool sets the FADV_DONTNEED hint on writes.
